title: collomia debilis subsp. ipomoea
intro: Collomia debilis subsp. ipomoea, commonly known as the delicate mountain bell, is a plant species in the phlox family (Polemoniaceae). The delicate mountain bell is known for its potential health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. Its therapeutic actions include soothing digestive issues, reducing anxiety, and promoting relaxation. The bioactive constituents of the delicate mountain bell plant include phenolic compounds, flavonoids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
